title: NBN POI 3HAW (Hawthorn) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Planned maintenance will move nbn services connected to the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne to a new router at Exhibition Exchange. Work is scheduled from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 8 September. Customers with nbn services on this POI may experience interruptions during the window, for up to 2 hours. Our team will complete the change and monitor services to restore connectivity as soon as the work is finished.

title: NBN POI 4NER (Nerang) Cable Replacement Works
current_summary: The planned backhaul cable replacement at the Nerang (4NER) POI has been rescheduled. Upstream notifications now show the maintenance occurring from 2026-09-02T14:00:00Z to 2026-09-02T20:00:00Z (00:00–06:00 AEST on 3 September 2026). One upstream notification for the earlier August window was removed; we are monitoring and will advise of any further changes.

title: National - Maintain the Network
current_summary: Planned maintenance by an upstream access network provider will now occur on 14 August 2026 from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST. Some services may lose connectivity during this window. Our team will monitor progress and work with network partners to minimise impact.
